# PPTX Generator

Generate professional PowerPoint presentations from structured content using the Gainwell corporate template.
page_texts.3:
[.utils/generators/pptx-generator/README.md#cli]

### CLI

```bash
python pptx-generator.py input.yaml -o output.pptx [-t template.pptx] [-v]
```
page_texts.4:
[.utils/generators/pptx-generator/README.md#via-task]

### Via Task

```bash
task generate:pptx -- input.yaml output.pptx
```
page_texts.6:
[.utils/generators/pptx-generator/README.md#input-format]

## Input Format

YAML or JSON file defining the presentation structure:

```yaml
title: "MMES Modernization Roadmap"
audience: "ELT"
slides:
  - type: title
    title: "MMES Modernization"
    subtitle: "Q2-Q4 2026 Roadmap"
  
  - type: section
    title: "Executive Summary"
    subtitle: "Key initiatives and milestones"
  
  - type: content
    title: "Current State"
    bullets:
      - "Legacy monolith architecture"
      - "High maintenance costs"
      - "Limited scalability"
  
  - type: agenda
    title: "Roadmap Overview"
    items:
      - "Q2: Core Platform"
      - "Q3: Data Migration"
      - "Q4: Cutover & Validation"
  
  - type: header_only
    title: "Timeline Visualization"
    # Add charts/diagrams manually or via future enhancement
```
page_texts.7:
[.utils/generators/pptx-generator/README.md#slide-types]

## Slide Types

| Type | Description | Use Case |
|------|-------------|----------|
| `title` | Title slide with subtitle | Opening slide |
| `section` | Section divider | Major topic transitions |
| `agenda` | Agenda with multiple items | Meeting outline |
| `content` | Title + bullets/content | Standard content slide |
| `header_only` | Title only (blank canvas) | Custom diagrams/charts |
page_texts.8:
[.utils/generators/pptx-generator/README.md#template]

## Template

Uses `docs/design/presentations/Gainwell_PPT_Template.pptx` by default.

The template includes:
- Gainwell branding and colors
- Multiple layout options
- Section dividers
- Agenda layouts
- Content layouts

## Examples

See `examples/` directory for sample input specs:

- `architecture-review.yaml` - Technical architecture deck
- `status-report.yaml` - Project status update
